annotations.title: Summarize what is in a bucket

description: A quick map of a bucket (or one folder) so large data can be understood before reading: file count and total size, the biggest folders, file types, the largest and newest files, and the date range. Looks at up to 5,000 files. Follow up with search_storage_files and read_storage_file for the details.

bucket.description: Bucket name (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens).

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

name: summarize_storage_bucket
title: Summarize what is in a bucket
